name: gitlab
description: Find repositories, read and create issues, inspect and comment on merge requests

fallback_auth.instruction_md: Create a GitLab.com personal access token with api scope for issue creation/comments, or read_api for reads only. Paste it here. Token expiry follows your GitLab policy.

io.github.personaljarvis.post_install_hint_md: Connect signs you in at GitLab.com in the browser — no token to copy. If the publisher OAuth client is not provisioned yet, the dialog offers the token fallback instead. Self-managed GitLab is not supported by this bundled connector.
io.github.personaljarvis.longevity_note: Browser login renews automatically. Pasted tokens expire on the date selected at creation.
